problem: Given $f(x,y,z)=x^3y^2z^2-\frac{3}{\ln z}$ on its real domain $z>0$, $z\ne1$, evaluate $\lim_{z\to1,\ z\ne1}f_{xyz}(-1,2,z)$. This asks for the continuous extension of the mixed derivative from the domain, not the undefined literal derivative $f_{xyz}(-1,2,1)$ of the original function. Differentiate on the domain and match an unchanged displayed choice. For verification, distinguish the source's formal substitution from its domain omission; do not infer its grade or key before observation.
